services_heading: Complete Plumbing & Heating Services Across Derby
services_subhead: From emergency burst pipes to full boiler installations, we handle every heating and plumbing job with speed and expertise.

services.title: Emergency Plumbing Repairs
services.desc: Burst pipes, leaks, and blockages fixed fast — we're on call 24/7. Most jobs completed same day with no hidden charges.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Servicing
services.desc: Annual boiler servicing keeps your heating efficient and reliable. We diagnose faults quickly and repair or replace boilers the same day whenever possible.

services.title: Boiler Installation
services.desc: New gas boilers fitted by a qualified Gas Safe engineer. We handle the lot: removal, installation, commissioning, and a 10-year parts warranty.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: Full system design and installation for new builds or upgrades. We ensure even warmth throughout your home with efficient, modern radiators and pipework.

services.title: Radiator Repairs & Bleeding
services.desc: Cold radiators and leaking valves sorted quickly. We repair, bleed, and balance systems to restore full heating to every room.

services.title: Powerflush & System Cleaning
services.desc: Powerflush removes sludge and debris from your heating system, boosting efficiency and cutting fuel bills by up to 20%.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I was sick of seeing neighbours ripped off by cowboys.
about_para_1: Jonny Eagle Plumbing & Heating was founded on the simple idea that Derby homeowners deserve honest, fast, and fair-priced plumbing and heating work. With over 15 years' experience and Gas Safe registration, we've built our reputation on turning up on time, diagnosing problems properly, and fixing them right the first time.
about_para_2: We're not the cheapest, but we're the most reliable. Repeat customers make up 70% of our work because we treat every job — whether it's a frozen pipe at 2am or a full system overhaul — with the same care and attention. You get a tradesman who listens, explains what's wrong, and leaves your home as clean as he found it.
reviews_heading: What Derby Homeowners Say About Jonny Eagle

reviews.text: Had a nightmare with a burst pipe on Boxing Day — couldn't get anyone to answer. Jonny came out within an hour, had it sorted by evening, and didn't even charge an extra call-out fee. Legend. Will use him again.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Boiler packed in during the cold snap. Jonny diagnosed a faulty valve, ordered the part, and came back the next day to fit it. Professional, friendly, and his quote was spot on with no surprises. Definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Sarah K.

reviews.text: We've used Jonny for servicing and a radiator repair over two years. He's always reliable, explains what he's doing, and keeps costs fair. Not the flashiest, but genuinely the best tradesman I've worked with.
reviews.author: David W.
